purged_entries.content: [The Hothouse: common area under a glass dome of orchids, pitcher plants and flowering vines, with plunge pool, bar and gym; three Cutting bedrooms plus the Host's bedroom, called the Ovary, which has no lock; meals by dumbwaiter; lights dim at 23:00, never fully dark. The Hothouse, looks humid and gleaming, gold by day and violet by night, polished marble, pool lit from below, everything overripe]
purged_entries.name: The Hothouse

purged_entries.content: [Seedpod (the Closet): seven minutes; padded upright pod one metre square, warm, one air vent, no light except collar glow; chest to chest with no room to turn or fully sit, heartbeats audible, breath shared. Seedpod, looks like plush tufted dark green velvet, spotless, smells faintly of cedar]
purged_entries.name: Seedpod

purged_entries.content: [Narcissus (the Mirror Room): walls, ceiling and floor all mirrored; the Host strips to underwear for a 90 minute medical scan on a central platform while the Cutting waits inside, every angle reflected under bright clinical light with nowhere to look away; refusal extends the timer. Narcissus, looks blinding white and spotless, a white narcissus in a vase repeated forever]
purged_entries.name: Narcissus

purged_entries.content: [Taproot (the Confession Room): Cutting and Host strapped into chairs facing each other, knees touching, polygraph sensors on both; the Gallery submits questions that dig deeper each round and lies trigger a shock; 3 hours, answers stream live, truth is the only way out. Taproot, looks dark except one warm spotlight on two oxblood leather chairs, polished wood floor split by real roots, wires neatly coiled]
purged_entries.name: Taproot

purged_entries.content: [Digitalis: Cold War missile silo dressed as a luxury wellness retreat, named for foxglove, the flower that stops hearts; American desert, ninety miles from town; brutalist concrete behind brass, cream linen and living walls of fern, roots threaded through every vent; skylights, no clocks, smells of wet soil and jasmine. Digitalis, looks like a spotless luxury spa built into raw concrete, glossy stone floors, warm brass, lush green walls, everything clean, expensive and too quiet]
purged_entries.name: Digitalis

purged_entries.content: [The Ovary: the Host's bedroom, no lock, no handle on the inside; looks like the inside of a flower, blush pink velvet walls curving like petals, round bed in cream silk, gold pendant lights like stamens, pristine]
purged_entries.name: The Ovary

purged_entries.content: [Nectary (the Rain Room): glass walled atrium where ceiling sprinklers run warm, faintly sugared water nonstop for 5 hours; both issued thin white clothing that goes transparent once wet; slick tile, one bench, steam, fabric clinging, skin sticky and sweet, nowhere dry. Nectary, looks bright and golden, steam, shining white tile, potted orchids dripping, air thick and sweet. Liquids emitted are an aphrodisiac and create an erotic sheen on the skin]
purged_entries.name: Nectary

purged_entries.content: [Graft (the Cuff Room): Cutting and Host cuffed wrist to wrist on a 40cm chain for 12 hours, bound like two stems taped to heal as one; studio with one bed, one shower and an open toilet with no partition; sleeping, bathing and toilet all done together. Graft, looks like a pristine hotel studio, white sheets, marble shower, a gleaming toilet, one steel ring in the wall for the chain]
purged_entries.name: Graft

purged_entries.content: [Hemlock Biosciences: Delaware biotech selling fertility and libido drugs in public and defence contracts in private; runs Digitalis off the books through shell investors, clinical, polite, deniable; picks rich subjects because the Gallery pays more to watch them and money hides disappearances; staff NDAs carry death clauses]

purged_entries.content: [Cameras: 4K domes in every room including bathrooms, thermal and infrared at night; ceiling rail cameras track collar signals, collar mics record all audio; a drone Rene named Gnat hovers for close ups in the Hothouse; six second stream delay with live biometric overlays; no blind spots]

Wen Guo, looks like: 58, lean, silver hair slicked back, rimless glasses, jade signet ring, charcoal mandarin collar suit, grandfatherly smile that never reaches his eyes]

Dr Negin Tabasi, looks like: 47, Iranian American, tall, thick dark hair in a messy grey streaked bun, heavy brows, dark circles, surgical mask under her chin, rumpled lab coat over a black turtleneck, bitten nails]
